label: cornersTurn90: the turn reads its degrees as radians, so a quarter turn lands somewhere else (.cornersTurn90)
find: private static func turn(_ degrees: Double) -> Matrix { Matrix.rotation(degrees: degrees) }
replace: private static func turn(_ degrees: Double) -> Matrix { Matrix.rotation(degrees: degrees * 180 / .pi) }

label: normalizesHalfTurn: a half turn wraps to -180 instead of staying at 180 (.normalizesHalfTurn)
flipKeepsCentre: a flip mirrors the box about the document origin, so it moves (.flipKeepsCentre)
find: return TransformBox(box: t.box, degrees: normalized(-t.degrees), flipX: flipX, flipY: flipY)
replace: let b = t.box; let box = direction == .horizontal ? Rect(minX: -b.maxX, minY: b.minY, maxX: -b.minX, maxY: b.maxY) : Rect(minX: b.minX, minY: -b.maxY, maxX: b.maxX, maxY: -b.minY); return TransformBox(box: box, degrees: normalized(-t.degrees), flipX: flipX, flipY: flipY)

label: anchoredCentre: a middle anchor sits at 1 instead of 1/2, so Canvas Size about the centre lands at the far edge (.anchoredCentre)
